name: Arpita
title: AI Developer
tagline: I build intelligent systems that read, reason and act.
about: I'm an AI developer based in Pune with a B.Tech in Artificial Intelligence and Data Science. I enjoy turning messy, real-world problems into reliable AI-powered products, from model to API to interface.
My toolkit spans OCR and document understanding, retrieval-augmented generation, local LLM deployment, and full-stack integration with Python, FastAPI and Angular.
Beyond code, I've published research on pomegranate disease detection using deep learning, and I've led student communities as Vice President of the AI & Data Science Department.

points: Design and ship AI-powered features end to end: data pipelines, model integration, APIs and UI.
Work across document intelligence, semantic search and LLM-based assistants.
